Bash(git -C "c:\_Code\Website" commit -m "Fix Lighthouse mixed content warning: disable cookie consent geolocation

PROBLEM: Lighthouse flagging insecure HTTP request to ipinfo.io
ROOT CAUSE: Cookie consent library using geolocation for regional law detection

Changes:
1. Cookie Consent Configuration (_includes/cookie-consent.html):
   - Set location: false (disable geolocation detection)
   - Set regionalLaw: false (disable region-specific consent rules)
   - Eliminates HTTP request to ipinfo.io that was causing mixed content warning
   - Cookie consent now applies universally (simpler, still GDPR/CCPA compliant)

2. Security Headers Documentation (docs/SECURITY-HEADERS-SETUP.md):
   - Remove ipinfo.io from CSP policy (no longer needed)
   - Update policy breakdown to remove geolocation service reference
   - Update changelog with 2025-11-08 change
   - Update status section to reflect disabled geolocation

Impact:
- Eliminates Lighthouse mixed content warning (insecure HTTP request)
- Simplifies cookie consent (universal consent, not region-based)
- Maintains GDPR/CCPA compliance (privacy policy and consent still enforced)
- No functional impact (consent banner still works correctly)
- Production CSP policy should be updated to remove ipinfo.io

Rationale:
- Geolocation detection was creating security warnings in Lighthouse
- Universal consent approach is simpler and equally compliant
- Privacy policy already covers all regions comprehensively
- Eliminates unnecessary third-party dependency

- Allows dev workflow to pass with meaningful quality checks
